\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Rolling forecasts from \rhoosSpanStart{} to \rhoosSpanEnd{}, every forecast made with a model estimated on its trailing window only, so every forecast is out of sample; each is scored against the actual realized variance of the closing half hour, $\RV_t$, on the $T_{\mathrm{oos}} = \rhoosDays$ trading days on which every forecast of both training schemes exists, early closes dropped (Section~\ref{sec:rh_results_eval}). The span starts with the intraday linear forecasts, on the first trading day after the pre-sample on which the penalties were selected (\cmPtValFirst{} to \cmPtValLast). The MSE entries are in units of $10^{-\rhoosMseExp}$: the printed number times $10^{-\rhoosMseExp}$ is the mean squared error $T_{\mathrm{oos}}^{-1}\sum_t (\RV_t - \hat\sigma^2_t)^2$. QLIKE is the mean QLIKE loss. $R^2_{\mathrm{OOS}} = 1 - \sum_t (\RV_t - \hat\sigma^2_t)^2 / \sum_t (\RV_t - \overline{\RV}_{t-1})^2$, in percent, where the benchmark $\overline{\RV}_{t-1}$ is the historical mean of the closing-half-hour realized variance over all trading days from \rhoosBenchStart{} to day $t-1$ \citep{CampbellThompson2008}. All features is the full predictor set of Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}; the OLS is estimated on the HAR benchmark only (--: no forecast). The same days for the models trained on the last 30 minutes are in Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos_last30} (Section~\ref{sec:rh_econ_last30}).
\item[a] The earlier draft's intraday specification: OLS on the HAR benchmark; LightGBM and XGBoost on all features.
\item[$\dagger$] Preliminary: the closing-interval forecasts of the intraday random forest on all features, from an exercise still in progress.
\end{tablenotes}
